# FocusGraph()

> **FocusGraph**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`, `Key` *extends* `string`, `Prefix` *extends* `string` = `Id`&gt;(`spec`: [`FocusGraphSpec`](../interfaces/FocusGraphSpec.md)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;): [`FocusGraphDefinition`](../interfaces/FocusGraphDefinition.md)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:142](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L142)

Build a complete focus graph from gameplay nodes, paths, joins and choices.

## Type Parameters

| Type Parameter | Default type |
| ------ | ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-id"></a> `Id` *extends* `string` | - |
| <a id="type-parameter-key"></a> `Key` *extends* `string` | - |
| <a id="type-parameter-prefix"></a> `Prefix` *extends* `string` | `Id` |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`FocusGraphSpec`](../interfaces/FocusGraphSpec.md)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt; |

## Returns

[`FocusGraphDefinition`](../interfaces/FocusGraphDefinition.md)&lt;`Id`, `Key`, `Prefix`&gt;

## Remarks

Rejects missing nodes, cycles, empty groups, and unavoidable mutually
exclusive prerequisites. Generated IDs are stable under node reordering. Use
the returned `focuses` references with `country.hasCompletedFocus` and
`country.completeFocus`. External/shared-focus graphs use the lower-level
FocusTree API, because this graph deliberately describes a closed DAG.

## Example

```ts
const tree = FocusGraph({
  id: "reconstruction", prefix: "REC",
  nodes: {
    charter: { cost: 3 },
    industry: { cost: 5, completionReward: c => c.effects.addPoliticalPower(50) },
    relief: { cost: 5 },
    assembly: { cost: 5 },
  },
  sequences: [["charter", "industry"], ["charter", "relief"]],
  choices: [["industry", "relief"]],
  joins: [{ to: "assembly", any: ["industry", "relief"] }],
});
```
